findings.summary: plan_to_wire did not re-check a built plan, so a literal $lineage set on mutable arguments (or a model_construct plan) could return from the store as a placeholder. Fixed: plan_to_wire re-applies the plan rules.
2c.4 validate_plan cannot revalidate a placeholder plan by model_validate of its dump; parked in the 2c.4 plan (revalidate via plan_from_wire(plan_to_wire(plan))).
No test showed a refused step in a put_plan batch leaves no plan row. Fixed in test_put_and_get_plan on both stores.
Gate evidence was not recorded at review time; recorded in the close ritual.
actions.plan_id has no foreign key or store check; parked in the 2c.6 plan before the kernel writes plan_id.
